channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: UN approves first carbon credits under Paris Agreement
item.description: The United Nations announced Thursday the approval of the first carbon credits under a global market aimed at reducing emissions, a mechanism that has faced scrutiny over greenwashing concerns.

item.title: Channel Tunnel operator GetLink eyes upsurge in UK-France travel
item.description: Channel Tunnel operator Getlink said Thursday it foresees high-speed passengers using the Channel Tunnel to rise by 10 million by 2030.

item.title: France's divided left faces tough choices in local elections
item.description: As France heads into local elections the divided parties of the left may have to make tough choices when it comes it election alliances, within the context of rising tensions after the killing of far-right activist Quentin Deranque.

item.title: French expression of the day: La fin des haricots
item.description: This French expression doesn’t technically mean you have run out of beans...

item.title: Foreigners in France scramble to apply for citizenship before rule change
item.description: New data from the French Interior ministry shows that citizenship applications in December doubled, as people scrambled to get their applications in before the start of tough new language requirements in 2026.

item.title: 'Given up hope' - French citizenship applicants hit by new language rules
item.description: Foreigners in France scrambled to make citizenship applications before the introduction of tougher language requirements at the start of 2026 - but some who applied before the deadline have also been asked for the B2 French test.

item.title: French grammar tip: When to use the preposition à vs de
item.description: The French prepositions 'à' and 'de' are two of the most common (and confusing!) to use - here's how to figure out which one is appropriate when you are speaking French.

item.title: 10 signs spring has arrived in France
item.description: Obviously the weather gets warmer, evenings get longer and flowers start to bloom, as they do in all northern hemisphere countries, but there are also some peculiarly French signs that spring has arrived.

item.title: The history of the French letter Ç
item.description: The letter ç (a cedilla or cédille in French) is a spelling detail with a long history.

item.title: Swastikas tagged at former Nazi transit camp near Paris
item.description: Two swastikas have been found spray-painted on buildings in a Paris suburb that served as a World War II transit camp for some 63,000 Jews deported to Auschwitz-Birkenau.
